title: Evaluation compatibility on integral representatives
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-coef-rational-verdier-comparison-evaluation, for every integral constructible representative K, the completed scalar evaluation square holds as a heterogeneous equality after applying the two prescribed localization normalizations. This is the representative calculation before transporting to an arbitrary raw rational object.

source.place: paragraph 3, comparison and evaluation/biduality compatibility; integral representative calculation

proof.text: Uncurry the actual homMap under the supplied adjunction. First-variable evaluation naturality transports the scalar-completion isomorphisms, giving the ordinary v-evaluation identity; counit naturality after internal Hom of u gives beta-evaluation. Naturality of the tensor completion map moves beta across inverse tensor completion. The tensor-only scalar/completion square and naturality of completedScalarComparison identify this with completed scalar extension of the integral completed evaluation.

Localize that integral equality. Use the rational tensor object and pure-tensor map specifications, the scalar extension object and pure-map specifications, and A.objects/B.objects to identify all endpoints. Transport hb through the tensor functor and B.evaluation_integral; transport A.evaluation_integral through scalar extension. Identify the inverse rational tensorator with the localized inverse integral tensorator by the hom normalization and inverse uniqueness. Compose the resulting HEqs with hu and the localized equality.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 3, evaluation by transposition; integral finite-extension evaluation paragraph

theorem normalizedExtension_evaluation_integral
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE) (B : Datum D l hl X L wL)
    (e : Extension D l hl X E L i wE wL A B)
    (hu : (HEq e.omega.hom ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l L X).map
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (X := (integralScalar l X E L i).obj wE.omega) (Y := wL.omega)
      (IntegralFiniteExtension.u l E L i X D hl wE wL)))))
    (hb : (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
    HEq (e.comparison.hom.app (op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)))
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l L X).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := (integralScalar l X E L i).obj
            ((IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l E X wE.omega.obj A.preserves).obj (op K)))
          (Y := (IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l L X wL.omega.obj B.preserves).obj
            (op ((integralScalar l X E L i).obj K)))
          (IntegralFiniteExtension.beta l E L i X D hl wE wL A.ordinary B.ordinary
            K.obj K.property.1))))) :
    ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X, HEq
      ((tensor D l hl X L).map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((scalar l X E L i).obj
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)))
          (e.comparison.hom.app (op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)))) ≫
        B.evaluation ((scalar l X E L i).obj
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)))
      ((@rationalTensorScalarComparison l _ E _ _ _ L _ _ _ i X (units D l hl X)).inv.app
        ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K,
          A.dual.obj (op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K))) ≫
        (scalar l X E L i).map (A.evaluation
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)) ≫ e.omega.hom)
